topic.title: Input ONLY PRCOHOT

body.p: Bi-directional PRCOHOT is no longer supported on the processors. BIOS should NOT inherit any PRCOHOT configurations from previous platform projects.
The PRCOHOT pin is default to be INPUT ONLY and should remain unprogrammed.
